panels.description: An old industrial train waits at Keel's rail gate beneath work lamps, dust and steam. Leave upper platform space.
The green rail authorization opens the gate without a confirmation chime. Leave upper gate space.
Alex, Ada and folded Bi11bot sit among workers and tool crates inside the train. Leave upper carriage space.
Through the window, Keel falls below as the train climbs toward bronze-lit Halyard. Leave upper window sky space.
